1	# Global Airport Performance Dataset
     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	This dataset contains operational performance metrics for 30 major international airports worldwide, covering passenger throughput, on-time performance, and route network size across six geographic regions.
     5	
     6	## Data Source
     7	
     8	### airports
     9	Each record represents one airport with the following fields:
    10	- **airport** (string): Airport name with IATA code in parentheses
    11	- **throughput_million** (float): Annual passenger throughput in millions of passengers, ranging from ~10 to ~94
    12	- **on_time_rate** (float): On-time departure/arrival performance as a percentage, ranging from ~70% to ~91%
    13	- **routes** (integer): Number of active airline routes served, ranging from 95 to 370
    14	- **region** (string): Geographic region — one of North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Latin America, or Africa
    15	
    16	## Data Notes
    17	- Throughput figures are approximate annual totals representative of recent pre-pandemic or recovery-period levels
    18	- On-time rate is a blended metric combining departure and arrival punctuality
    19	- Route counts reflect unique city-pair connections and may vary seasonally; figures represent peak-season snapshots
    20	- Three airports are designated for annotation: Atlanta (highest throughput), Dubai (mega-hub with high throughput), and Tokyo Haneda (highest on-time rate)

import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

airports = data['airports']['data']

# Extract fields
names = [a['airport'] for a in airports]
throughput = [a['throughput_million'] for a in airports]
on_time = [a['on_time_rate'] for a in airports]
routes = [a['routes'] for a in airports]
regions = [a['region'] for a in airports]

# Region colors - professional business palette
region_colors = {
    'North America': '#1f4e79',
    'Europe': '#c55a11',
    'Asia-Pacific': '#548235',
    'Middle East': '#7030a0',
    'Latin America': '#bf9000',
    'Africa': '#7f7f7f'
}

colors = [region_colors[r] for r in regions]

# Bubble sizes - scale route count for visibility
# Using sqrt scaling for area perception
min_r, max_r = min(routes), max(routes)
sizes = [((r - min_r) / (max_r - min_r) * 800 + 150) for r in routes]

# Setup figure
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'sans-serif'
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 10
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8), dpi=150)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#ffffff')
ax.set_facecolor('#fafafa')

# Grid
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4, color='#999999')
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# Plot bubbles
scatter = ax.scatter(throughput, on_time, s=sizes, c=colors, alpha=0.75, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.2, zorder=3)

# Annotations for specific airports
annotations = {
    'Atlanta (ATL)': {'text': 'Atlanta\nHighest throughput', 'offset': (25, -3), 'ha': 'left'},
    'Dubai (DXB)': {'text': 'Dubai\nMega-hub', 'offset': (15, 4), 'ha': 'left'},
    'Tokyo Haneda (HND)': {'text': 'Tokyo Haneda\nHighest on-time', 'offset': (-20, 5), 'ha': 'right'}
}

for name, info in annotations.items():
    idx = names.index(name)
    x, y = throughput[idx], on_time[idx]
    dx, dy = info['offset']
    ax.annotate(
        info['text'],
        xy=(x, y),
        xytext=(x + dx, y + dy),
        fontsize=9,
        fontweight='bold',
        ha=info['ha'],
        va='bottom',
        color='#333333',
        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#555555', lw=1.0),
        zorder=5,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#fff8dc', edgecolor='#cccccc', alpha=0.95)
    )

# Labels for all airports (small, non-overlapping where possible)
for i, name in enumerate(names):
    if name not in annotations:
        short_name = name.split(' (')[0]
        ax.text(throughput[i], on_time[i], short_name, fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=4)

# Axes
ax.set_xlabel('Annual Passenger Throughput (million passengers)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')
ax.set_ylabel('On-Time Performance (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')
ax.set_title('Airport Throughput vs. On-Time Performance\nBubble size = Number of routes', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=15)

# Axis limits with padding
x_min, x_max = min(throughput), max(throughput)
y_min, y_max = min(on_time), max(on_time)
ax.set_xlim(x_min - 8, x_max + 15)
ax.set_ylim(y_min - 3, y_max + 6)

# Legend for regions
legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=r, alpha=0.85) for r, c in region_colors.items()]
legend1 = ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, title='Region', loc='lower left', frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=False, fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
legend1.get_frame().set_facecolor('#ffffff')
legend1.get_frame().set_edgecolor('#cccccc')

# Legend for bubble sizes
size_labels = [100, 200, 300, 370]
size_legend_vals = [((s - min_r) / (max_r - min_r) * 800 + 150) for s in size_labels]
size_legend = ax.scatter([], [], s=size_legend_vals[0], c='#888888', alpha=0.6, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1)
legend2 = ax.legend([size_legend], ['Route count'], loc='lower right', frameon=True, fancybox=True, fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
legend2.get_frame().set_facecolor('#ffffff')
legend2.get_frame().set_edgecolor('#cccccc')

# Add size reference circles in legend area manually
for i, (sl, sv) in enumerate(zip(size_labels, size_legend_vals)):
    ax.scatter([], [], s=sv, c='#888888', alpha=0.5, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1, label=f'{sl} routes')

# Rebuild legend with both
ax.legend(handles=legend_patches + [ax.scatter([], [], s=((s - min_r) / (max_r - min_r) * 800 + 150), c='#888888', alpha=0.5, edgecolors='white', linewidths=1, label=f'{s} routes') for s in size_labels],
          title='Region | Route Count', loc='lower left', frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=False, fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)

# Tidy up spines
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color('#cccccc')
    spine.set_linewidth(0.8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
